author: Staff Report
title: UTV driver killed in two-vehicle wreck in Shelby area of Madison County - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Report ,
6 hours ago An unnamed driver of a Utility Terrain Vehicle (UTV) was killed Wednesday afternoon in Madison County when the vehicle was struck in the northbound lanes of S. Seminole Trail in the 3700 block of the highway. PJR photo courtesy Madison County GIS.
Virginia State Police report it’s investigating a fatal two-vehicle crash that occurred at approximately 3:30 p.m., Wednesday afternoon, in the 3700 block of S. Seminole Trail in Madison County.
A utility terrain vehicle (UTV) was crossing the northbound lanes of S. Seminole Trail when it was struck by a Subaru Crosstrek.
The driver of the UTV died at the scene.
The driver of the Subaru was transported to an area hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
A UTV (Utility Terrain Vehicle) – commonly called a side-by-side – is a rugged off-road vehicle designed to haul heavy loads, traverse rough terrain, and carry passengers.
The northbound lanes of Rt. 29 between Shelby and Wolftown-Hood roads were blocked for nearly three hours as fire and rescue personnel and law enforcement worked the scene.
Madison County Sheriff’s Office, Madison County Fire Company, Madison County Emergency Medical Services, and Virginia Department of Transportation assisted
The crash remains under investigation.
